research_scope: Destructo-Disc — base-game Ki Blast Super acquisition and core behavior.

verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The current Xenoverse 2 reference identifies Destructo-Disc as a 100-Ki Super obtained through Krillin training. A separate Xenoverse 2 reference independently describes the same training acquisition.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The current reference describes a slow disc projectile with homing/tracking behavior, strong resistance to guarding, and restand/stun behavior on hit.
verification_audit.probability_policy: No PQ drop probability or Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted because the researched acquisition evidence points to mentor training rather than a PQ reward.
verification_audit.version_policy: No exact damage percentage is promoted to a canonical field because the available mechanic/damage figures may vary by version and context.

records.name: Destructo-Disc
records.character_source: Krillin; also used by Android 18, Imperfect Cell, and Cell Jr.
records.skill_description: Fires a disc-shaped Ki Blast with slow travel but strong homing/tracking; the attack is difficult to guard and can create a restand opportunity on hit.
records.mechanics_notes: The current reference documents a slow startup and projectile speed, homing behavior, and the ability to retarget after firing when initially unlocked. It also documents restand/stun behavior on hit and reduced-but-not-zero damage through guarding.
records.pve_notes: The current reference notes usefulness in Expert Missions when the target is distracted, but this is contextual gameplay guidance rather than a universal performance claim.
